title: Large deviations for sparse systems of moving particles
summary: We study large deviations for rare clusters in sparse systems of moving particles. In the regime \(nr_n^d\to0\) and \(ρ_{k,n}=n^kr_n^{d(k-1)}\to\infty\), we prove a large deviation principle for the empirical measure of isolated \(k\)-particle trajectory clusters. The speed is \(ρ_{k,n}\), and the rate function is the relative entropy \(h(\,\cdot\,\midτ_k)\), where the finite reference measure \(τ_k\) explicitly incorporates the underlying path law.
